name: XCPETS #25532 Mobo
description: Mobo, a Legendary Sarutobi (Hatchling) on xcpets.fun. This token is pet #25532's token: once it is tied to the pet by an on-chain pet:deed burn, whoever holds it owns the pet in the xcpets.fun game (from Bitcoin block 972,729) and can sell, buy or gift it in Spam City Games.
